result.brief: 提出判别式得分函数DSF，从预训练判别模型（ResNet、DETR、DINOv2）的损失梯度几何中提取图像空间生成场，无需训练即可实现无条件生成、条件引导、编辑与修复，并用于零样本量化校准。
result.reason: Extracts generative field from pretrained discriminative models including DINOv2 ViT encoders, probing implicit data-manifold structure in visual representations; relevant to representation learning and generative latent space.
